function startAutoplay(host): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/awards-carousel/autoplay.ts:21

Starts the auto-advance ticker. Bails (and actively stops any running cycle) under reduced-motion or before ≥50% visibility — autoplay must never run on an unseen or motion-sensitive carousel. Re-bases the clock on each start so a fresh cycle always gets a full dwell.

Parameters

host

AwardsCarousel

The AwardsCarousel element.

Returns

void
